package.description: Simplified design, management & system control platform

en-US.description: Simplified design, management & system control platform
en-US.longDescription: With this single OS platform, we offer the most intuitive way of designing and managing your installation. Easily configure audio processing and integrate third-party tools. Create custom user dashboards without coding, enabling system control from any device. For more complex solutions, use LUA for tailor-made control scripts. This offers a unified platform for quick integrations and immersive user experiences.
en-US.name: AudacTouch

zh-CN.description: 简化设计、管理与系统控制平台
zh-CN.longDescription: 通过一体化操作系统平台，我们为您提供最直观的安装设计与管理方案。轻松配置音频处理模块并无缝集成第三方工具。无需编程即可创建个性化用户控制面板，实现多终端设备操控。针对复杂需求，更支持使用 LUA 语言编写定制化控制脚本。该平台打造了统一解决方案，助力快速系统集成，成就沉浸式用户体验。
